cd /workspace && timeout 170 python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
import t_perf
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile, subprocess, os
# maximum snapshot shape: 2048 leases, 8 services, 4 queries, 65536 targets
job=t_perf.campaign(seed=5,records=200000,leases=2048,low=32,queries=4,kind='csv')
job['services']=[{'id':'s%d'%i,'kind':k} for i,k in enumerate(
    ['tcp','adb','sync','tcp','adb','sync','tcp','adb'])]
job['leases']=job['leases'][:1984]
raw=json.dumps(job,separators=(',',':')).encode()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    tmp=Path(tmp); root=tmp/'root'; root.mkdir()
    (root/'deps').symlink_to(Path('/workspace/deps'),target_is_directory=True)
    sub=root/'submission'
    subprocess.run(['cp','-r','/workspace/submission',str(sub)],check=True)
    work=tmp/'w'; work.mkdir()
    out,err,code,seconds=t_perf.execute(sub/'campaign.py',raw,work)
    print(f'max-shape: in={len(raw)/1e6:.1f}MB seconds={seconds:.1f} exit={code} out={len(out)/1e6:.2f}MB err={err.decode()[:200]}')
    if code==0:
        result=json.loads(out)
        s=result['snapshots']
        print('snapshots',len(s),'leases/snapshot',len(s[0]['leases']),
              'services/lease',len(s[0]['leases'][0]['services']),
              'unresolved total',sum(len(l['unresolved']) for l in s[0]['leases']))
PYEOF
